content.title: Did Timothée Chalamet win an Oscar for 'Marty Supreme?'
content.text: As March rolled in, awards season was in full bloom.The month kicked off with the 32nd annual Actor Awards, where “Sinners” star Wunmi Mosaku stunned in a bright red Louis Vuitton gown. Other fashion highlights included Kate Aimee Lou Wood in Versace and Timothée Chalamet in Prada, among many others.More from VarietyAt the same time, some of Hollywood’s biggest names headed to Paris for Fashion Week. Priyanka Chopra Jonas and “Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr. & Carolyn Bessette” star Paul Anthony Kelly hit the Dior show, as did Charlize Theron and Anya Taylor-Joy.The red carpet was rolled out in New York City for Nicole Kidman and Jamie Lee Curtis, who reunited at the Season 1 premiere of their new series “Scarpetta.” Uptown, on the same night, Christian Bale, Jessie Buckley and Maggie Gyllenhaal marked the U.S. debut of “The Bride!”Keep checking back all month for the best celebrity red carpet and event photos of March 2026.Best of VarietySign up for Variety's Newsletter.
